mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_judge_language_limit ( question_id, language, time_limit_ms, memory_limit_kb, output_limit_kb, confirmed, confirmed_at, source_config_id ) VALUES ( #{questionId}, #{language}, #{timeLimitMs}, #{memoryLimitKb}, #{outputLimitKb}, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{sourceConfigId} ) ON CONFLICT (question_id, language) DO UPDATE SET time_limit_ms = EXCLUDED.time_limit_ms, memory_limit_kb = EXCLUDED.memory_limit_kb, output_limit_kb = EXCLUDED.output_limit_kb, confirmed = TRUE, confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, source_config_id = EXCLUDED.source_config_id
